workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are their common available 30-minute slots for next week:
Mon: 09:00-10:00
Tue: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 15:00-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
Fri: 11:00-12:00

Could you please check Elena's and David's calendars and find a 30-minute slot that works for them as well? If you find a common slot, please let me know, and I will book it. Thanks, Alison

workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. It looks like the only time that works for all four partners is Thursday, November 19, from 14:30 to 15:00.
